description:
Take charge of your health. Learn more about Apollo ProHealth here: https://bit.ly/3uYGOLF 
#BeProHealth
In this video, Abhi and Niyu discuss how stress has been affecting our lives. Stress though seems to us like a petty issue, in the long run can impact our physical, mental, emotional and sexual health. The video also focuses on how stress can be minimised by some effective techniques thus making our lives 1% healthier, happier and better!

A video by Abhiraj Rajadhyaksha & Niyati Mavinkurve

#stress #impactonhealth #abhiandniyu

What exactly is stress doing to us?

STRESS has been slow-poisoning us. It has been making us weaker day by day. We get stressed by small situations like missing a train or getting less marks in school or college tests.

Everyone does face difficult situations, but is taking tension or being stressed-out the RIGHT SOLUTION?? Definitely not! Since it not only makes us panic about an easy-to-deal situation, but it impacts our health including hair-fall, ageing and many more. The video throws light on how one can handle and overcome STRESS, perform better and lead a happy life. 

This video is helpful for students on how to deal with exam pressures or low grades and how they can gear up and perform confidently in upcoming exams. This video will also guide professionals on how to manage a stress-free work-life balance, so that they can enjoy their work and give their 100%.

From experience,
I am a no good do person. I haven't accomplished anything and even If I did, I destroyed it by comparing. I felt bad for my achievements at time when no one was there to celebrate it. Just so you know the story doesn't end in a bad way, I am currently earning more than enough and can give my friends and family gifts whenever they want. I am focussing on my health and food. I am studying while I am working. 
I have dealt with all kinds of stress. Academic stress(biggest challenge of my life never came first always second and my parents at time made it feel like I was failing), Relationship stress- No good rel with my friends even living alone rn, Financial stress ( never asked anything from my parents because I knew they couldn't afford it and my parents boasted off about it) and even now when I am earning so much I am unable to spend it on myself because it makes me feel guilty somehow, Health stress- I was diagnosed with spinal tuberculosis and was bedridden for 2 years still recovering ( there was a point I accepted death because dr told us at one point that It could be cancer and went for a biopsy). 
I won't say I am  happy now but I am satisfied with what I have and I look forward to do more but it's time we stopped taking stress of something that might not happen.. I am going to stop it as of today and try to live my live, if not enjoy then at least focus on what's important for me and what can I do about it. Stop thinking about short term goals (I mean make goals but keep them malleable there is more than one way to get where you want to be) and see the bigger picture and then accomplish them by taking actions. Actions are what matters.

Hi, I'm a 14 yo boy from West Bengal. Since last year, around May I suddenly noticed something completely different which I had never experienced before. It was as if like I was very low confident/nervous, I didn't know what it was but later I understood, I had Anxiety. & It was extremely serious, kept on going for about two months (june - July) in that period I was vomiting a lot (4-5 times a day) , stressed out and didn't know how get out of it. It was kinda difficult for me to share with my family members as I was sort of ashamed, so I kept it myself. It became so severe that I even had to go for an "Ultrasonography test".  till then I didn't know about this term called, "Anxiety". Unknowingly, I started to interpret various negetive things about this incident and that caused it even for harsh.


So, one day I decided I can't live like this anymore, I had to change. So, then I started meditation (10 mins everyday) started reading this book called ("IKIGAI") also started workout and focused on my diet. Since, then I had never a packet of chips nor even a cold drink. For, those who're experiencing this similar experience start meditation it can drastically change your life❤

In my opinion, Understanding stress requires first acknowledging that India is home to 130 million people divided into three socio-economic classes: high, middle, and low. 
Eradicating this significant income disparity is essential to alleviate stress stemming from financial hardships. Achieving financial stability and independence for all individuals in India will naturally lessen the competitive and cutthroat atmosphere surrounding wealth, subsequently fostering a stress-free environment that alone could lessen the stress level to almost 60 percent. 
Now we all know too much of everything is bad. 
So my point is In any sector, the progress should align with the skills and workforce available, fostering teamwork. It is crucial to support a culture where employees feel comfortable taking sick leave without feeling ashamed or guilty for not fulfilling their duties. Colleagues should provide assurance and support during such times. Excessive development in any field is nothing but a product of greed that creates targets in schools, hospitals, and businesses which must be prevented to avoid creating unnecessary pressure. With abundant global resources to feed every human, there is no need for panic or chaos. Addressing this issue could lead to a 90% decrease in stress levels in India. Additionally, to achieve complete 100 percent stress relief, individuals should prioritize empathy and understanding towards one another. By prioritizing this, development and economic growth will naturally follow. 
In a nutshell only we human beings can help each other out of the situation based on foundation of trust, empathy and teamwork.
